name: Afflicted Lurgy
description: Chance to apply poison on hit.

stats.notes: Applies on every strike. The second value is the documented double-stack chance.

name: Aftershock
description: Chance to add Arcanic damage on hit.

stats.notes: Applies on each hit. Despite the in-game description, this does not add weapon damage.
On an Arcanic proc, damage is dealt over two ticks at 50% of the triggering hit per tick. Each tick is affected by Enemy Armour. This status behavior is unchanged by double-stacking.

name: Arcane Alacrity
description: Magick Heavy Attacks charge more quickly.

stats.notes: Applies to Magick Heavy Attack charging and stacks multiplicatively with Headlong.

name: Arcane Barrage
description: Increased Damage and Stagger during Heavy Cast Attacks.

stats.notes: Applies to Heavy Casts.
Applies to Heavy Casts. The magnitude is undocumented; the page states that double-stacking doubles it.

name: Arcane Rebound
description: Deflected Magick projectiles deal increased damage.

stats.notes: Applies to deflected Magick projectiles. Both values are approximate; the second is derived from the documented doubling rule.

name: Bounding Swipe
description: Increased Damage and Stagger while Sprinting.

stats.notes: Applies to running attacks.
Applies to running attacks. The magnitude is undocumented; the page states that double-stacking doubles it.

name: Breakneck
description: Heavy Attacks charge more quickly.

stats.notes: Applies to Melee Heavy Attack charging and stacks multiplicatively with Headlong.

name: Bypass
description: Enemy defense reduced on first hit.

stats.ranks: 10 Armour on First Hit/10 Armour on First Two Hits
stats.notes: A single stack reduces Enemy Armour on the first hit. Double-stacking permits one additional reduction on the second hit. Duration and total cap are undocumented.

name: Cowp
description: Grants chance for doubled Stagger damage.

stats.notes: On a successful proc, the hit deals twice its normal Stagger damage.

name: Dual Cast
description: Chance for a second projectile to be cast.

stats.notes: Applies to projectile-based Magick attacks. The duplicate carries the original projectile's Rune effects, including Archstorm and The Hollowing interactions.
It is assumed, but unconfirmed, that Finishers and Ground Finishers are excluded. This applicability is unchanged by double-stacking.
It is assumed, but unconfirmed, that projectiles deflected with Mirrorspell are excluded. This applicability is unchanged by double-stacking.

name: Enkindled
description: Chance to add fire damage on hit.

stats.notes: Applies on hit. The proc does not appear to stack; that non-stacking behavior is not fully confirmed.

stats.ranks: 35% Hit Damage per Second/35% Hit Damage per Second
stats.notes: A burning target takes this damage each second for four seconds. The proc does not appear to stack. This status behavior is unchanged by double-stacking.
Enemy Armour is reduced by up to this amount while burning, then recovers gradually for six seconds after the burn ends. This status behavior is unchanged by double-stacking.

name: First Strike
description: Increased weapon damage against foes with full Life.

stats.notes: Applies when the foe is at full Life.

name: Fleet Fling
description: Increased Throw Speed.

stats.notes: Applies to weapon throws.

name: Follow Up
description: Increased weapon damage on consecutive attacks following a Heavy Attack.

stats.ranks: 7 Damage per Hit, 28 Maximum/14 Damage per Hit, 56 Maximum
stats.notes: Consecutive Light Attacks after any Heavy Attack accumulate this bonus. Damage is affected by move multipliers.

name: Fortified
description: Take less Stagger damage when blocking.

stats.notes: Applies while blocking. The magnitude is undocumented; the page states that double-stacking doubles it.

name: From Above
description: Increased weapon damage from Aerial Attacks.

stats.notes: Applies to aerial hits and is affected by move multipliers, so the displayed increase may be lower on many weapons.

name: Full Force
description: Increased Damage and Stagger during Heavy Attacks.

stats.notes: Applies to Heavy Attacks.
Applies to Heavy Attacks. The magnitude is undocumented; the page states that double-stacking doubles it.

name: Galvanic Strike
description: Adds Voltaic damage to weapon, staggering enemies in area of effect when it discharges.

stats.notes: Applies on each hit. Despite the in-game description, this does not add weapon damage.

name: Hale and Hearty
description: Increased weapon damage at full Life.

stats.notes: Applies while the Envoy is at full Life.

name: Heightened Parry
description: Increased parry window.

stats.notes: Applies to Parries and cannot appear on Magick weapons. The magnitude is undocumented; the page states that double-stacking doubles it.

name: Hunter's Relish
description: Increased Life recovery when attacking during regain.

stats.notes: Applies to regain hits. A single stack produces 2% additional lifesteal up to the regain cap; the second value follows the documented doubling rule.

name: Quick Draw
description: Bows charge more quickly.

stats.notes: Applies to Bow charging. Both values are approximate and require further confirmation.

name: Rejoinder
description: Increased Damage and Stagger during dodge attacks.

stats.notes: Applies to Dodge Attacks, including Spectre Strikes, before the Spectre Strike multiplier.

name: Renewed Slayer
description: Restore Life upon slaying a foe.

stats.ranks: 5 Life per Second for 4 Seconds/10 Life per Second for 4 Seconds
stats.notes: Triggers after slaying a foe. A later kill starts another instance that stacks during overlap. Taking damage interrupts the healing.

name: Rupture
description: Increased Shatter and Stagger damage.

stats.notes: Applies when embedded arrows are splintered by the Splinter Combat Art. The second value follows the documented doubling rule.
The magnitude is undocumented, and it is unconfirmed whether this applies to all Bow shots or only Splinter. The page states that double-stacking doubles it.

name: Savagery
description: Chance to add Bleed damage on hit.

stats.notes: Applies on hit.

stats.ranks: 20% Attack Damage per Tick/20% Attack Damage per Tick
stats.notes: On a Bleed proc, damage is dealt for five ticks. This status behavior is unchanged by double-stacking.

name: Sinister Volley
description: Chance to inflict fear to foes when thrown weapon hits.

stats.notes: Applies on weapon throw. The chance is undocumented and does not appear to work on Bosses; the page states that double-stacking doubles it.

name: Slinger's Tempo
description: Chance for Stagger to become Knockdown.

stats.notes: On staggering a foe, a proc converts Stagger to Knockdown and enables a Ground Finisher. Ground Finishers do not receive the Lethality Multiplier.

name: Sullying Force
description: Increased chance of Smite.

stats.notes: Adds this chance to proc Smite.

name: Swift Strike
description: Increased weapon attack speed.

stats.notes: Also affects Envoy kicks and unarmed strikes while the weapon is thrown.

name: Swooning Blow
description: Increased Stagger while attacking.

stats.notes: Applies on hit.

name: Sympathy Pang
description: Damage inflicted from attacks will spread to another.

stats.notes: Applies on hit to a nearby foe and is not affected by Enemy Armour. It can propagate statuses, consumes additional Fellust charges, and can trigger Barkbare to steal Enemy Armour.

name: Unencumbered
description: Increased weapon damage while no sidearm is equipped.

stats.notes: Applies while the Envoy has no Sidearm equipped.

name: Unnerving Blow
description: Chance to inflict fear on foes when hit.

stats.notes: Applies on hit. The chance is undocumented and does not appear to work on Bosses; the page states that double-stacking doubles it.

name: Venger
description: Increased Riposte Damage.

stats.notes: Applies before the Riposte Multiplier, is unaffected by the Lethality Multiplier, and does not scale with Grace. It cannot appear on Magick weapons.
